text:
Predicates:
Politician(x) ::: x is a politician.
MemberOf(x, y) ::: x is a member of y.
Nazi(x) ::: x is a Nazi.
German(x) ::: x is German.
PartOf(x, y) ::: x is part of y.

Premises:
HeinrichScmidt ::: Heinrich Scmidt.
Nazi(HeinrichScmidt) ::: Heinrich Scmidt was a Nazi German politician.
MemberOf(HeinrichScmidt, PrussianStateParliament) ::: He is a member of the Prussian State Parliament.
MemberOf(HeinrichScmidt, NaziReichstag) ::: He is a member of the Nazi Reichstag.

Conclusion:
∀x (Politician(x) → ¬PartOf(x, NaziReichstag)) ::: No politicians are part of the Nazi Reichstag.
